component.name: nutmeg
component.summary: Play Roblox with the macOS client through rosemary

description.p: nutmeg is a Roblox bootstrapper for Linux. It downloads the macOS Roblox client from Roblox's servers, keeps it up to date, and starts it through rosemary, which runs macOS programs on Linux.

It opens Play links from roblox.com, can show the game you are playing on Discord, and uses the rosemary runners and bottles that Butter has installed. rosemary is experimental, and so is running Roblox on it.
